Name: Faster Transition
Author: kumagabear
Description:
This mod customize duration fade in/out warp transition or make it no transition at all

I know someone already make [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7354]No Transitions[/url][/b] but the split second of the black screen feels weird so I tried to make my own

If you have [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/b] you can customize the duration or no transition

Beware of the [b]No transition[/b] mode i'm still testing it, my current playthrough use it and so far there are no problem but I'm still not sure 100%
Report to me if you found bugs
